title: Black Out Challenge: Try to Stay Awake
description:
Tonight I’m not asking for much, pet… just one thing: prove you can stay with Me when I say the words.

The Black Out Challenge is a slow, controlled game of attention and surrender—soft countdowns, deliberate pacing, and that delicious moment where your thoughts start to thin… like ice melting under warm hands. Each time I test you, you’ll feel it: the dimming behind your eyes, the quiet slip, the way your body relaxes when your mind stops trying so hard.

You can try to resist. You can try to stay bright and sharp and in control.

But you already know what happens when I tell you to black out.

Headphones on. Lights low. Let Me take you apart gently… and show you how easy it is to drop for Me.
author: Mistress Amethyst
